profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Software engineer, I enjoy designing and developing software products. I continuously strive to become a better software craftsman.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer. Joined as an individual contributor of the product team. Some of my highlights during my tenure in Wizeline:

  - Contributed to the design and implementation of one of the most crucial feature releases in our "Portfolio" product, the "custom fields".
  - Significantly contributed to the architectural design of the web application of our new product line, Wizeline Roadmap, after pitching a set of design patterns to solve issues we had back then, supported by a POC of such patterns.
  - Created abstractions and tooling to implement common patterns across Wizeline Roadmap's web application, such as CRUDing helpers that usually come out of the box with application frameworks of the pre React/Redux/etc era, application-wide alerts, etc.
  - Jumped into DevOps to support our micro services architecture powered by Kubernetes; built the developer tooling to easily spin up full development/test environments for testing out new features before shipping them to production, enabling a better continuous delivery workflow.
  - Delivered technical talks in Wizeline Academy events in the spirit of sharing our experience with certain software engineering topics.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer. Joined and eventually led a team in charge of designing and building a search API powered by Elasticsearch.

  - Developed backend services in Go for one of Ooyala's biggest projects at the time.
  - Designed and developed a REST-like API for searching video content metadata.
  - Collaborated with other teams to spec the interfaces of the project's backend services.
  - Designed the Elasticsearch indices to get the most out of its potential for our use cases.
  - Created tooling for ES maintenance operations.

Also delivered talks at local universities (ITESO and ITESM) representing Ooyala

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack software developer. Crafted software products with high-quality standards, delivering carefully built and tested product features.

All of the software projects I worked on at Crowd Interactive involved a Ruby On Rails backend, these projects included:

 - An iOS app for a store to sell Crowd branded apparel and other items built with Ruby Motion
 - The redesign of an e-commerce platform which used Backbone for the web app
 - Bootstrapped a marketplace-like product for a San Francisco based startup, powered by an Ember.js app

positions.title: Software developer
positions.description:
Full stack web developer.

I worked on developing single page applications backed by Ruby On Rails APIs. During this time I gained experience with Javascript and used Backbone.js extensively as a base framework for building web applications.

I developed an internal tool to abstract some common patterns in our Backbone applications, reducing boilerplate code and new projects setup and bootstrapping efforts.

positions.title: Software developer
positions.description:
Full stack web developer.
Backend: PHP with CodeIgniter
